resources.string: Voice audio, written messages and learning requests are sent directly to Google Gemini and billed to your Google AI project, which may include a free tier. The key stays encrypted on this phone. Google data handling terms apply.
No Mural minute limit. Voice, written messages and learning requests use your Gemini key and are billed to your Google AI project.
To use Gemini for voice and written conversations, choose My Gemini key under Conversation access. Mural minutes use Mural\'s hosted service and cannot be used with Gemini voice.
Voice audio, written messages and learning requests are sent to Google Gemini and billed to your Google AI project. Google data handling terms apply.

Voice audio, written messages and learning requests will be sent to Google Gemini and billed to your Google AI project. Google data handling terms apply. Mural minutes remain available if you switch back.
Add your Gemini key in Settings to begin.
